queries.response:
nesnd_jp_reply_valid.trigger_if.scope:jp_sender:
  nesnd_jp_regime: "scope:jp_sender_regime"
  has_journal_entry: "nesnd_jp_foreign"
  NOT:
    this: "scope:jp_partner"
  nesnd_jp_country: yes
  trigger_if:
    [0]:
      nesnd_jp_diplomatic_standing: yes
      limit:
        OR:
          nesnd_jp_request_kind:
            [0]: 1
            [1]: 2
            [2]: 6
            [3]: 7
    [1]:
      limit:
        exists: "var:nesnd_jp_request_partner"
      var:nesnd_jp_request_partner: "scope:jp_partner"
      NOT:
        has_war_with: "scope:jp_partner"
    [2]:
      limit:
        is_subject: yes
      overlord: "scope:jp_sender_patron"
    [3]:
      is_direct_subject_of: "scope:jp_partner"
      limit:
        OR:
          nesnd_jp_request_kind:
            [0]: 1
            [1]: 2
            [2]: 3
            [3]: 7
      scope:jp_partner:
        nesnd_jp_regime: "scope:jp_partner_regime"
    [4]:
      limit:
        nesnd_jp_request_kind: 1
      can_increase_autonomy: yes
    [5]:
      NOT:
        has_variable: "nesnd_jp_political_done"
      limit:
        nesnd_jp_request_kind: 3
    [6]:
      limit:
        [0]:
          nesnd_jp_request_kind: 4
        [1]: "nesnd_jp_request_quote"
        [2]: ">"
        [3]: 0
    [7]:
      trigger_if:
        limit:
          exists: "scope:jp_korea"
        scope:jp_korea:
          trigger_else:
            scope:jp_partner: "this"
          is_country_alive: yes
          trigger_if:
            overlord: "scope:jp_partner"
            limit:
              is_subject: yes
      NOT:
        any_scope_state:
          OR:
            state_region:
              [0]: "s:STATE_BUSAN"
              [1]: "s:STATE_YANGHO"
          NOT:
            controller: "owner"
      any_scope_state:
        NOR:
          state_region:
            [0]: "s:STATE_BUSAN"
            [1]: "s:STATE_YANGHO"
      trigger_else:
        always: no
      limit:
        nesnd_jp_request_kind: 5
      is_active_in_diplomatic_play: no
      is_subject: no
      is_at_war: no
    [8]:
      nesnd_jp_union_pair_valid: yes
      limit:
        nesnd_jp_request_kind: 6
  trigger_else:
    [0]:
      always: no
    [1]:
      scope:jp_sender_patron: "this"
  nesnd_jp_request_number: "scope:jp_request_number"
  has_variable: [nesnd_jp_request_clock, nesnd_jp_request_kind, >=, ...] (7 items)

nesnd_jp_independence_play.possible.trigger_if:
  overlord:
    is_active_in_diplomatic_play:
      [0]: no
      [1]: "relations:root"
      [2]: "<"
      [3]: "relations_threshold:cordial"
  OR:
    any_diplomatic_catalyst:
      is_diplomatic_catalyst_type: "catalyst_autonomy_increase_denied"
      target: "root.overlord"
    can_increase_autonomy: no
  NOT:
    has_truce_with: "overlord"
  trigger_if:
    limit:
      overlord:
        is_subject: yes
    overlord.overlord:
      [0]:
        [0]: "relations:root"
        [1]: "<"
        [2]: "relations_threshold:cordial"
  limit:
    is_subject: yes
    exists: "overlord"

nesnd_jp_protected_ports.desc.first_valid:
  triggered_desc:

  desc: "nesnd_jp_protected_ports_desc"
